# om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100

Several official filenames appear upstream; advertised version alone is not byte identity.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md). **Advertised version:** 1.1. **Internal build:** 1100.

**Container SHA-256:** not recorded in this entry.

Several official filenames appear upstream; advertised version alone is not byte identity.

## Technical reference

- [Take section bounds from the loader, not from 0xFF runs](../reference/hazard.ff-is-not-free.md): An 0xFF run in the file can lie outside the section load, so code placed there is never loaded.
- [Point OSD picture descriptors into the heap](../reference/hazard.osd-pictures-in-heap.md): A picture descriptor pointing into a patch code tail blanked the rest of the OM-3 menu.
- [Gate on section initialisation, not on the load request](../reference/hazard.ready-not-requested.md): A section's copy or load-request bit can be set before its constructors run.
- [Only call code in a section that has already loaded](../reference/hazard.section-load-order.md): Sections load one after another; a hook calling a later section can run before its target exists.
- [Keep work done with interrupts masked short](../reference/hazard.short-masked-windows.md): Long work between the firmware lock and unlock runs with interrupts off.
- [Section copied mask](../reference/om3-1100.copied-mask.md): One bit per section, set when its copy returns; not proof its constructors have run.
- [fclose](../reference/om3-1100.fclose.md): Stock file close on the memory card.
- [fopen](../reference/om3-1100.fopen.md): Stock file open on the memory card.
- [fread](../reference/om3-1100.fread.md): Stock file read from the memory card.
- [free](../reference/om3-1100.free.md): Stock heap free, the counterpart of malloc.
- [GUI state word pointer](../reference/om3-1100.gui-state-pointer.md): Holds the address of the GUI state word: u16, child << 8 | parent.
- [Half-press hook](../reference/om3-1100.half-press-hook.md): A shutter half-press path used to run code once the card is ready.
- [Hue/lightness builder call site](../reference/om3-1100.hue-lightness-call.md): Where the colour stage calls the hue/lightness builder; Caduceus hooks here.
- [Lock (masks interrupts)](../reference/om3-1100.interrupt-lock.md): Firmware lock; with d0 = 0 it sets the PSW interrupt mask to 0 until the unlock.
- [malloc](../reference/om3-1100.malloc.md): Stock heap allocator, class 1 pool.
- [Settings getter (active profile)](../reference/om3-1100.profile-getter.md): Stock settings getter; with setting 63153 it returns the active colour profile.
- [Screen factory table](../reference/om3-1100.screen-factory.md): Pairs GUI screen classes with screen ids.
- [Section 1 free tail](../reference/om3-1100.section-1-tail.md): Unused 0xFF bytes at the end of section 1, which loads first.
- [Section 4 free tail](../reference/om3-1100.section-4-tail.md): Unused 0xFF bytes inside the end of section 4's load.
- [Section 9 free tail](../reference/om3-1100.section-9-tail.md): Unused 0xFF bytes inside the end of section 9's load; 404 bytes.
- [Section loader](../reference/om3-1100.section-loader.md): Copies section n from flash to its run-time range and then sets its bit in the copied mask.
- [Section descriptor table](../reference/om3-1100.section-table.md): Ten 12-byte rows: run-time start, flash source and a flag for sections 1 to 10.
- [Setting getter by id](../reference/om3-1100.setting-getter.md): Returns a setting by setting id; the debug getter Caduceus and OM-Emu call.
- [Start a software timer](../reference/om3-1100.timer-start.md): Arms a software timer: d0 = event id, d1 = duration in ms.
- [Software timer table](../reference/om3-1100.timer-table.md): Ten 28-byte software timers: active, start time, event id and duration in ms.
- [Touch timer re-arm](../reference/om3-1100.touch-timer-rearm.md): Shared touch code re-arms event 500 at 8000 ms here after a tap.
